## Vocabulary in Context (6 points)
Read each sentence. Choose one option that explains the bold word or phrase as it is used in that sentence.
**3.** The coach’s **reversal** on weekend training surprised the players.

What does **reversal** mean here? (1 point)
A. a change to the opposite decision
B. a delay before making a decision
C. a refusal to discuss a decision
Correct answer: <i>A. a change to the opposite decision</i>
